name: Mature Comedy Visual Novel
source:
Experience a world filled with awful people - and you're one of them! You embark on a journey to get your awful catgirl girlfriend some illicit materials, intense and prolonged misery immediately ensues.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2411370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
体验一个充斥着烂人的世界——而且你自己就是其中之一！为了替你那同样烂透了的猫娘女友搞来一些违禁品，你踏上了一段旅途，而漫长又煎熬的倒霉苦难也随之接踵而至。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2411370/]Steam[/url]]
